Quests.Title: A Light Carried Home
Quests.Summary: A paid city service job available from the start. Carry a real sealed reserve from Cinder Dispatch to the Pressure House. Damage or entering a vehicle drops the recoverable parcel. Nothing is taken from your inventory.
Quests.Done: Tamsin installed the reserve. The block has a clean backup and Corin has recorded your delivery. This completed job pays once.
Quests.Floor: Cinder Dispatch and Pressure House, ground floors
Quests.Entrance: Cinder Dispatch front door, across Veyra Avenue from the Veyra Lofts

Lines.Speaker: Corin Pell
Lines.Text: Tamsin needs a reserve at the Pressure House. Carry it yourself, keep it out of a vehicle, and fit it at her fuse cabinet. If a hit knocks it loose, recover the parcel marker. If you leave the job, it returns here.

Steps.Objective: Carry the reserve to the Pressure House fuse cabinet. Fit it, then stay for 3 seconds. Recover it if dropped.

Lines.Speaker: Tamsin Reyes
Lines.Text: The reserve is fitted. You gave this block another safe night. Corin will see the signed delivery.

Steps.Objective: Leave through the Pressure House front door to finish the delivery and receive payment.
